title: Foundation Courses
line: Build your living soil foundational knowledge as we take you through the 4 foundational courses: Foundation Course 1: Introduction to the Soil Food Web Foundation Course 2: BioComplete™ Compost Foundation Course 3: BioComplete™ Liquid Amendments Foundation Course 4: Microscopy

title: Complete Practicum
line: Begin with all four of the foundation courses to gain the foundational knowledge needed to understand the role and importance of the soil food web, as well as why microscopy is the best analysis method when the goal is efficient identification and population counts for the main beneficial soil microbes in the soil food web. Then move on to gaining practical hands-on skills in all four of our Advanced programs.

title: Soil Microscopy
line: Seeing is believing, and when it comes to the regeneration of living soil, a microscope is your most powerful ally: Become a Soil Food Web Lab Tech, See what your soil really needs before spending time and money to improve it, Measure the real impact of your efforts near instantly, No more sending samples across the country for assessment | Complete on-site assessments yourself

title: BioComplete™ Compost Production
line: Learn to produce biologically complete compost that restores soil life, suppresses disease, and transforms what’s possible on your land. Discover how to redirect organic waste into a biologically rich amendment, grow the right microbes to support healthy soil and plants while minimizing the risk of human pathogens and weed seeds, and replace expensive, harmful chemical inputs with the power of biology and organic matter.

title: Compost Intensive Course
line: The Compost Intensive Course is a hands-on, 10-week online training designed to guide you through the process from beginning to end alongside a global cohort of peers. There are NO prerequisites! And it counts toward your consultant pathway*

title: Learn the Art and Science of Biological Liquid Amendments
line: Build on your Soil Food Web Microscopy and BioComplete™ Compost Production skills by learning to purposefully breed, multiply, and extract key microbes for various real world field application needs

title: Advanced Field Trial
line: You've learned to see life in a microscope slide. You've built biologically complete compost from the ground up. You've brewed and applied biological liquid amendments. You understand, at a cellular level, what healthy soil looks like and why it matters. Now it's time to prove it in the field.

title: Workshops
line: Build BioComplete™ Compost, create biological liquid amendments, and practice microscopy alongside Dr. Elaine's team of experienced mentors and an international community.

title: Introduction to Ecosystem Restoration
line: Developed in Partnership with Ecosystem Restoration Communities Joining this course connects you with the Ecosystem Restoration Communities (ERC) – a vibrant network of individuals and groups dedicated to restoring ecosystems worldwide.

title: Permaculture Design Certification
line: Whole-system design: water, plants, structures, community, rooted in living soil.

title: Intro to the Foundation Courses
line: A 10-lesson mini course into the world of Living Soil and all the ways it can help regenerate the world's living systems. Walk away with a broad view of just how impactful this work can be when applied consistently by educated land stewards and practitioners.

title: Mini Foundation Course
kicker: This Is Where It All Began
line: Learn directly from the source with this Intro to the Foundations Mini Course.
